nodes.label: Claimable Neon
nodes.rationale: Provisions a temporary project before a human creates an account. The agent holds an identity assertion, not a Neon API key, and neon claim refuses --api-key and --profile. Postgres is always granted. Auth and the Data API are granted when requested. Functions, Object Storage, and the AI Gateway return granted false with reason requires_claim; report those denied capabilities and do not retry or strip them. The project is created in aws-us-east-2 unless --region-id is set, and the region cannot change after create. Do not mint a claim URL until the human is ready. Opening the URL does not freeze access. Continuing to Neon rotates DATABASE_URL and revokes existing access tokens. A claim code lasts expires_in (15 minutes, 900 seconds, today); each mint cancels the previous unused code. When reconciled is true, the pre-claim DATABASE_URL no longer works. External JWKS is accepted only after claim. An agent must not complete the claim. Only invalid_grant, project_expired, and project_claimed mean the stored identity assertion is dead; token_expired means re-exchange it. The claimable resource is /v1/projects/{id}, not /v1/databases/{id}. Unclaimed projects expire at project_expires_at (72 hours today), independent of the claim-code clock.

hyperedges.label: Capabilities denied until a Claimable project is claimed
